description: Dialogs taller than the screen opened with their buttons off screen: DialogWindow was SizeToContent with no size cap and no scrolling
repro_steps: 1366x768 at 125 % (or 1920x1080 at 100 % with 4+ sale lines): open Nova venda -> Cobrar is below the bottom edge; same for the appointment, worker and cash-out dialogs

description: Appointment dialog about 1200 DIP wide, wider than small laptop screens
repro_steps: 1280x800 or 1366x768 at 125 %: Agenda > Nova cita -> the right part of the week picker is off screen

description: Client record: a long client name is cut off in the title, and history dates are truncated
repro_steps: Any screen: open the record of a client with a long name -> title and dd/MM/yyyy dates cut off

description: Owner mode: the Lock button at the bottom of the navigation is cut off
repro_steps: 1366x768 at 125 %: open owner mode -> Bloquejar only partly visible, no way to scroll to it

description: Sales page: Client and Concept columns collapse to zero width; filter labels and Netejar filtres clipped
repro_steps: 1366x768 at 100 % or smaller: Vendes -> Client and Concepte columns empty

description: Home and Till summary cards clip four-digit amounts
repro_steps: 1366x768 at 100 %: Home in owner mode with more than 1.000 EUR charged today -> figure cut off

description: Agenda: date range squeezed to nothing in the toolbar; fixed 400 DIP day panel crushes the week grid
repro_steps: 1280x800 at 125 %: Agenda, open a day in the week view -> no range title, day columns about 50 DIP

description: Reports: ranking names cut off and the sales chart loses its latest months
repro_steps: 1366x768 at 125 %: Informes -> client names cut, last bars missing

description: Names shortened with no tooltip (client browser rows, workers weekly overview); Spanish headers too narrow in Reports and Catalog
repro_steps: Spanish, any screen: Informes worker ranking 'Ventas atendidas' cut off

description: Catalan week range reads 'de octubre' instead of 'd'octubre' (no elision before a vowel)
repro_steps: Catalan: Agenda in a week inside October -> '8 – 10 de octubre 2026'

description: Closing the app threw InvalidOperationException (Close while a Window is closing) when the day's backup was already done
repro_steps: Close the app once (backup taken), reopen, close again -> crash in MainWindow.OnClosing: the no-backup path completes synchronously and Close() runs inside Closing

description: Sale dialog crashed (NullReferenceException) on + Servei / + Producte with nothing picked in the combo next to it
repro_steps: Nova venda -> leave the service combo empty -> click + Servei (same with + Producte)

description: With the language set to Spanish only the navigation was in Spanish; every page stayed in Catalan (the Windows language). Texts used the thread culture, which WPF puts back to the Windows one after the startup operation that set the language
repro_steps: Configuració -> Idioma -> Castellà, restart -> sidebar in Spanish, page content (e.g. Configuració) in Catalan

description: E-01 Restoring a backup older than the RenameToEnglish migration failed after the live database had already been replaced: the prune that follows read the settings table, which the old schema does not have; the dialog stayed open and the app did not close
repro_steps: Configuració -> Restaurar còpia -> pick a copy made by v1.0 -> 'error inesperat', the dialog stays open, the app keeps running on the unmigrated file and every page fails

description: E-02 A failure early in startup (appsettings.json missing or corrupt, no DatabasePath, data folder not creatable) left an invisible process holding the single-instance mutex, and nothing reached the log
repro_steps: Delete appsettings.json next to EvaGest.exe and start it -> generic message, no window; every later launch says EvaGest is already open until the process is ended in Task Manager

description: E-03 The appointment dialog's loading task was never observed: if it failed the dialog opened half empty with no message and no log, and saving an edit wiped the appointment's service and worker
repro_steps: Agenda -> open a guest appointment while the database is locked (e.g. during a backup) -> empty combos, no error; Guardar -> service and worker set to null

description: E-04 A backup copy that failed while being written (lock after every retry, disk full) left its file behind; an empty *_auto.db / *_close.db then counted as the day's copy, took a retention slot and was offered for restore
repro_steps: Fill the disk (or hold the database locked) at startup -> automatic backup fails; next start -> no new copy is attempted and Configuració shows an empty backup as the last one

description: E-05 A backup that was written correctly was reported as failed when the prune after it, or recording its date, threw (unreadable backups folder, settings write failing)
repro_steps: Fer còpia ara with a file in Backups locked/vanishing during the listing -> 'error inesperat' although the copy exists; the failed-backup notice stays up

description: E-06 Creating or renaming a payment method or expense category to a name that already exists (including a deactivated one) crashed into the generic error and lost what was typed
repro_steps: Catàleg -> Mètodes de pagament -> Nou -> 'Efectiu' (or the name of a deactivated method) -> 'error inesperat', dialog already closed

description: E-07 A sale could be charged twice: reading the confirmation-sound setting after the sale was saved could throw, leaving the sale dialog open on an already saved sale
repro_steps: Cobrar with the settings read failing after Create -> dialog stays open; Cobrar again -> a second identical sale

description: E-08 Fer còpia ara and the safety copy before a restore showed the generic error for ordinary I/O failures (disk full, folder not writable, database locked) instead of saying no copy was taken
repro_steps: Make the Backups folder read-only -> Fer còpia ara -> 'error inesperat' with no hint of what to do

description: E-09 Page dialogs closed before their page saved: if the save then failed, everything typed in the dialog was lost behind the generic error
repro_steps: Catàleg/Clients/Caixa/Treballadores -> Nou -> fill in -> save fails in the database -> dialog gone, data lost

description: E-10 The global error handler marked every exception handled and showed one message box per occurrence: a repeating error produced a stream of dialogs, and one raised with no main window open left the process running
repro_steps: Any exception thrown repeatedly by a timer or binding -> a message box after every one

description: E-11 Agenda worker filter never retried: if loading the workers failed on the first visit, the filter stayed with only Tots/Sense assignar for the whole session
repro_steps: Open Agenda while the database is locked -> afterwards the filter never lists the workers until restart

description: E-12 Week grid: a failed load left the header showing the new range over the old columns (the suspected crash on arrow keys before the first load was a false positive: the grid always has its columns)
repro_steps: Agenda -> navigate while the database fails -> header and columns disagree

description: E-13 Settings page treated a failed load as loaded: fields not read kept their defaults and saved-as-edited controls behaved as if those defaults were stored
repro_steps: Open Configuració while the settings read fails halfway -> page looks loaded with default values

description: Mouse wheel over a table did not scroll the page: SmoothScroll only let the ScrollViewer nearest the pointer move, which was the DataGrid's own (nothing to scroll), and WPF's ScrollViewer.OnMouseWheel then swallowed the event
repro_steps: Clients (or any page with a long table) -> pointer over the table -> wheel -> the page does not move; with the pointer beside the table it does

description: B-01 Caixa: the period dates were worked out only when the period was picked, and the page lives for the whole session; an app left open overnight showed yesterday under Avui and dated new movements yesterday
repro_steps: Leave EvaGest open past midnight -> Caixa -> Avui shows the previous day's figures; Entrada -> the date defaults to yesterday

description: B-02 Vendes: the filter lists were filled once per session, so anything created later (client, service, product, worker, method) could not be filtered on; sleeping clients were never listed
repro_steps: Open Vendes, then create a client -> back to Vendes -> the client filter does not offer them until restart

description: B-03 Deleting a worker named only on cash-outs (salary, commission) deleted her for good, and SET NULL removed her from those payments with no audit row
repro_steps: Caixa -> Sortida paying Marta; Treballadores -> delete Marta (no appointments or sales) -> the payment no longer names anyone

description: B-04 Workers report counted service lines, not units: a service with quantity 2 on one line counted as one (products already counted units)
repro_steps: Nova venda -> Tall with quantity 2 for Marta -> Informes -> Marta's services show Tall 1

description: B-05 Clients born on 29 February never got the birthday notice in a non-leap year
repro_steps: Client born 29/02/2000 -> open Inici on 28/02 of a non-leap year -> no birthday notice

description: B-06 ClientService.Update wrote back every column from the edit dialog's model, which has no Asleep, so editing an asleep client woke them (latent: Edit is only offered on the active list)
repro_steps: Call Update with a dialog-built model for an asleep client -> Asleep becomes false

description: B-07 Client search did not escape LIKE wildcards: typing _ or % matched every client
repro_steps: Clients -> search _ -> every client is listed

description: B-08 Without opening hours set, the Agenda and the appointment window's grid shrank to the hours of the appointments shown: one appointment cut the grid off where it ended
repro_steps: No schedules configured -> Agenda -> book a 10:00-10:30 appointment -> the grid shows only 10:00-11:00 (same in the slot picker of Nova cita)

description: B-09 Worker weekly overview headers are in English (Mon, Tue... Sun): WorkersViewModel.DayNames uses Weekday.ToString() instead of a localised name
repro_steps: Owner mode -> Treballadores -> create a worker with a schedule -> the Horari setmanal grid reads Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun

description: B-10 Workers table action column (Editar / Marcar inactiva / Eliminar) is clipped: Width=Auto next to star columns collapses it, Editar is not visible at all
repro_steps: 1920x1080 at 125 %, window maximised: Treballadores -> create a worker -> right after saving only a red sliver shows; after leaving and returning, Editar is hidden and the status button reads ...car inactiva

description: B-11 Clients page with no clients shows an empty table (headers Nom / Mobil only) instead of an empty state that invites to add one
repro_steps: Fresh database -> Clients -> blank table, no message

description: B-12 Vendes with no sales at all says Cap venda coincideix amb aquests filtres and offers Netejar filtres, though no filter is set
repro_steps: Fresh database, owner mode -> Vendes -> misleading message; it should invite to make the first sale

description: B-13 Catalogue picker (Veure la llista in Nova venda) with an empty catalogue says Res no coincideix amb la cerca. Prova amb una altra paraula, though nothing was typed
repro_steps: Fresh database -> Nova venda -> Afegir a la venda: Veure la llista -> misleading message; it should say the catalogue is empty and where to add services

description: B-14 Other empty tables with no empty state on a fresh database: Cataleg Serveis and Productes, Caixa Moviments, Informes client rankings and worker ranking
repro_steps: Fresh database, owner mode -> visit Cataleg, Caixa, Informes -> header-only tables / empty boxes

description: B-15 Sales footer says 1 vendes actives (plural with one sale): ActiveSalesCount has no singular form
repro_steps: Make one sale -> Vendes -> footer reads 1 vendes actives

description: B-16 prepare-test-session.ps1 can fail with New-Item: already exists right after Remove-Item of EvaGest-Proves (Windows deletes the folder asynchronously)
repro_steps: Run .\scripts\prepare-test-session.ps1 -Mode Fresh when EvaGest-Proves exists -> intermittently fails at New-Item; rerunning works

description: B-17 On a new install every appointment warns L'hora cau fora de l'horari de la barberia: with no shop opening hours configured at all, AvailabilityService.IsInsideSchedule is false for every time
repro_steps: Fresh database (no Configuracio > Horari d'obertura set) -> Nova cita at any hour -> yellow notice that the time is outside the shop hours
solved: by design: with no opening hours every time is outside them; set them in Configuracio

description: B-18 Nova cita slot picker draws the Aquesta cita marker on top of an existing appointment at the same time: both labels overlap and neither can be read
repro_steps: Book a 10:00 appointment -> Nova cita again (it proposes 10:00 too) -> in the picker grid 10:00-10:30 Joan... and Aquesta cita are drawn in the same box

description: B-19 Sale from an appointment for an unregistered client does not fit the shop screen: with the guest notice and the quick-service buttons, the payment method row is pushed under the pinned buttons and the form must be scrolled
repro_steps: 1920x1080 at 125 % (816 DIP high): appointment for a guest (Client nou) -> Realitzada -> Nova venda (des de cita): Bizum / Efectiu / Targeta half hidden; scrolling moves the title away

description: B-20 Informes > Fa temps que no venen lists clients seen today (0 dies): it ranks every client with a sale by last visit with no minimum, so with few clients it shows whoever came today
repro_steps: Make a sale to a registered client today -> Informes -> Fa temps que no venen: Joan Sanchez - 0 dies - today's date

description: B-21 At the main window's minimum width (1000 DIP) page toolbars are cut off on the right: Agenda loses + Nova cita, Caixa loses + Sortida
repro_steps: Restore the main window and narrow it to its minimum width -> Agenda: only a blue sliver of + Nova cita; Caixa: + Sortida cut
